entry.transcription: Patrick came over from County Mayo in 1867, a boy of nineteen with his brother Michael. He went into the Schuylkill mines that same winter. He never spoke of the crossing, my mother said, except once, that the water had been very bad. He married Mary Kelly at St. Patrick's in Pottsville and they had the two children, James and Margaret. He was a quiet man and a hard worker, and he died of the miner's asthma in 1908.
